formal function definitions.prefix:
definition prefix :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a list \<Rightarrow> bool"
  where "prefix xs ys \<longleftrightarrow> (\<exists>zs. ys = xs @ zs)"

formal theorem statement: theorem prefix_induction_property: "\<forall>xs ys. prefix xs ys \<longrightarrow> length xs \<le> length ys"
